summary: Fort Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the grant of 102,857 restricted share units (RSUs) under its Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. Grants include 30,000 RSUs to an officer and 72,857 to consultants, vesting half on June 22, 2027, with one-eighth of the remainder quarterly thereafter. The filing is routine equity compensation disclosure and does not constitute a special situation. It references a potential future acquisition of Logia USA Inc., but no definitive terms are filed, so no deal category applies. What to watch: any definitive agreement regarding Logia USA would trigger a separate filing.
